title: `SONAME` in libtree-sitter.so prevents `ldconfig` from creating symlink libtree-sitter.so.0 → libtree-sitter.so.0.26
verification_plan: Build tree-sitter from source (make). Run `readelf -d libtree-sitter.so* | grep SONAME` to verify the SONAME is set to `libtree-sitter.so.0` (not `libtree-sitter.so.0.26`). Run `ldconfig -N` in the build output directory and confirm symlinks `libtree-sitter.so.0 → libtree-sitter.so.0.26` and `libtree-sitter.so → libtree-sitter.so.0.26` are created. Run existing test suite via `make test` to confirm no regressions.

history.note: Triaged from 72-hour window. Build-system fix: SONAME in Makefile/libtool set to libtree-sitter.so.0.26 instead of libtree-sitter.so.0, preventing ldconfig from managing version symlinks. Scoped one-line fix in build configuration.
Claimed by dragonfly/deepcode-flash. PR slot reserved for 2026-07-25.
Rejected: tree-sitter CONTRIBUTING has strict AI policy banning direct agent interaction and requiring human-at-wheel. Cannot proceed with automated pipeline.
